_note: swc/1.4, 42-s2ko: the Coppa Italia (bracket numbers from last season, the fixed bracket) and the Supercoppa on v14_ita_playoffs' Italy with the real 2026-27 clubs of Serie A, B and C (it.wikipedia "Serie A/B/C 2026-2027", "Squadre partecipanti"; host words are placeholders). The Coppa Italia Serie C here is still the 4-club placeholder of v14_ita_playoffs (its real format: 42-s2ko M2). The Coppa Italia Serie D (42-s2ko M2b) on Serie D 2026-27's 9 groups (it.wikipedia town tables; host words placeholders, files 91-92).

competitions._source: Lega Pro C.U. n. 36/L of 29/07/2026 (the regulation): 56 clubs in 4 geographic groups of 14 (numbers 5-60 drawn, the lower number at home = a drawn host), the 4 Serie C clubs of the Coppa Italia as seeds in round 2 (one per group by proximity, at home), drawn within each group to the last 16, an open draw from the quarter-finals, semi-finals and final over two legs (points, goal difference = the aggregate; extra time, penalties), single matches straight to penalties. The groups by proximity (Davide 09/11, 42-s2ko Q1): each club's town (it.wikipedia 2026-27 season pages, Wikidata coordinates) to the nearest of the 2026-27 groups' centres with room; on the real 2026-27 clubs 53 of 56 land in their real group (Forli, Picerno, Grosseto do not), the 4 seeds all. Season 1: C.U. 1/CIT (groups, rounds 1-2, the last 16) with the hosts as played -- three field swaps under art. 5 (C.U. 11/CIT: Spezia-Vado, Trento-Desenzano; 20/CIT: Dolomiti Bellunesi-Desenzano) --, the quarter-finals as drawn (C.U. 22/CIT); results: it.wikipedia.

LND Dipartimento Interregionale C.U. n. 1 of 06/08/2026 (the regulation): every Serie D club (162); a preliminary round of 34 ties (art. 1: the 36 promoted, the 8 relegated from Serie C, the 17 play-out winners and clubs safe by more than 8 points, the 6 re-admitted, the worst of the Coppa Disciplina), a first round of the 34 winners and the 94 others (art. 2), then the main bracket of 64 (art. 3), the last 32 / 16 / 8 paired by the Dipartimento (art. 4); hosts drawn up to the round of 64 (art. 9), from the last 32 alternation (art. 4: the club away in its previous tie hosts; both home or both away: drawn); single matches straight to penalties (art. 5); semi-finals drawn, two legs, points then goals, then penalties directly (art. 6-7); the final two legs until the LND decides (art. 8: two legs or one neutral match; Davide 09/11, Q3). Later seasons (Davide 09/11): the preliminary = the clubs new to Serie D (promoted, relegated from C, re-admitted = the engine's fill-ins, Q2), then the others from the bottom of last season's tables up (the play-out survivors; the Coppa Disciplina place to the next of them, Q2) -- the Mod's entry order; the pairs drawn within geographic blocks (the pool halved by geography: blocks of 2 in the preliminary, 4 in round 1 -- calibrated on 2026-27: 2740 / 3977 km in all against the real 2610 / 4048), the bracket above them fixed. Season 1: the real draw and results (Transfermarkt ITC4, the data session's coppa_italia_serie_d_2627.json); the ties TM leaves out of the last 32 / 16 from the unused winners in order.

Lega Serie A C.U. n. 253 of 27/05/2024 (regulation 2024-25 .. 2026-27): 3.1 the Ranking a-g and the numbers 1-44, Allegato 1 the bracket, 3.2-3.8 hosts and deciders; the 2026-27 numbers and the field swap Palermo (25) - Lecce (17) in the round of 64: it.wikipedia 'Coppa Italia 2026-2027'. The C group winners / runners-up are ranked by points per match (as applied in 2026-27: groups of 20 and 19 clubs), the C.U. says points; the substitute 'meglio classificata ex art. 49 NOIF' of the national play-off's 2nd round = place, then points per match (Ravenna in 2026-27). 'unknown' (MC Q5 2, declared, not C.U.; approved by Davide 09/11/2026): a fact the save lacks -> the holder = the champion; promoted / relegated = by place; the play-off final's loser = the best placed non-promoted of B 3rd-8th; the play-out winner = the 16th; the C play-off winner or the Coppa Italia Serie C winner = the 2nd round's best (the C.U.'s own substitute, also 'if the Coppa Italia Serie C is not played'); the 2nd round's clubs = C places 2-10. Not in the C.U. either (declared, approved 09/11/2026): a holder that is a Serie B club staying in B makes 13 candidates for the 12 places of 9-20 -- the list order decides, the 3rd promoted club goes to 25-36.

Lega Serie A C.U. n. 43 of 01/10/2026: one match, extra time, penalties; the champion v the Coppa Italia winner, its finalist when they are one club (Inter v Lazio, Meazza, 22/12/2026); venue: neutral (Q4, MC); 'unknown' (declared, approved by Davide 09/11/2026): the cup winner / finalist -> Serie A's 2nd.
